name: Thyra Cave
description: Kemet necromancers are developing an advanced technique to reanimate undead dragons. They take the bodies of these creatures to the Dark Lab to experiment and create powerful undead from their remains. They are now trying to locate Thyra’s hideout on a secret island within Storm Island territory. If they can reanimate an avatar dragon, the devastation it might bring could be catastrophic. Some agents of the Draconic Council are recruiting adventurers to find this location before the kemet does, to remove her body, in case she is really dead. Adventurers might not only discover her body but also her unimaginable treasures and dragon eggs. Solnertha has an even more ambitious dream. She learned that the body of a dead Ungod lies in the central sea. If it could be reanimated, maybe the Kemet could annihilate all enemies using this monster.
